'''Lerian''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Appearance ==
She is young and skinny with sandy hair.

== Activities ==
She takes [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Faile Bashere]] into the Throne Room of [[Caemlyn]] to meet with [[Rand al'Thor]].

She is one of the Maidens who stand guard in Rand's camp in [[Arad Doman]].

She has taken to guarding [[Min Farshaw]]. When Rand returns to [[Tear]] she rushes off to inform the rest of the Aiel he is back.
She guards Rand when he [[Travel]]s back into Arad Doman.
